history.summary: Plan r1 committed (AnsibleSpecs 5f0d7b8): cross-cutting task shape; eleven phases, in order: kaniko2 (JenkinsPipelineUtils), the tunnel-reclaim pin (KubeCoderDeploy), the relay pin (ArgoCDDeploy), registry-cleanup, version-poller and the matrix/pin-stage go-live with Keycloak's per-build pin (DockerImages), the dry-run unsuspension and Operator Action card (RegistryDeploy), the design doc, D53, and two deploy-repo comment sweeps; 19 verification criteria covering R1-R5 and D1-D3. P7's Target ../RegistryDeploy resolves only after the operator adds RegistryDeploy to .kubecoder/config.yaml and runs kc env restart (close-out A1); every other Target resolves under --dry-run.

Criteria map 1:1 and the citations hold. Three points need the operator: D1's would-delete list is routed away from the test phase through owed_after, and the dry-run-off card is filed before any list exists; P1, P2, P3, P6 and P7 push repos that roll prd (the estate-wide shared library, the prd poller, prd Keycloak) before their review, with no ruling like slice 026's D1/F5; P10a-P10b review an empty diff for about 46 pushed deploy repos.
